# Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory

> The Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory conducts advanced research and engineering in Computer Networking, Cloud Computing, and Cyber Security at Telkom University, Indonesia.

Maintain-EIM is the central pre-launch ("Coming Soon") and scheduled maintenance edge gateway hub for all EIM Lab digital services (`*.eimlab.org`).

## Research Domains
- **Computer Networking:** Design, analysis, and testing of network architectures, routing & switching protocols, and optimization of enterprise-scale data communication infrastructure.
- **Cloud Computing:** Exploration of cloud computing services, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), server & network virtualization, and hybrid data center infrastructure integration.
- **Cyber Security:** Implementation of network security, system vulnerability analysis, penetration testing (pentesting), encryption auditing, and digital information asset protection.

## Core Laboratory Information
- **Laboratory Name:** Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory
- **Organization / Campus:** Telkom University, Bandung, Indonesia
- **Location:** TULT Building 8th Floor, Room TULT.08.09
- **Official Website:** https://eimlab.org
- **Central Maintenance Hub:** https://maintenance-eim.pages.dev/
- **GitHub Organization:** https://github.com/LABEIM
- **Contact Email:** lab@eimlab.org

## Architecture & Edge Routing
- **Central Gateway Strategy:** Single deployment of this repository to Cloudflare Pages (`maintenance-eim.pages.dev`).
- **Cloudflare Worker Router (`eim-edge-router`):** Intercepts requests across `*.eimlab.org` and dynamically serves either pre-launch Coming Soon landing pages (`200 OK`), Scheduled Maintenance notices (`503 Service Unavailable`), or proxies to the live application.
- **Zero Git Pollution:** Eliminates temporary maintenance branches in downstream application repositories.

- [Public Lecture Series](https://github.com/LABEIM/KU-EIM): Industry tech talks, academic seminars, and public workshops (`?site=kuliahumum`).
- [Smart Campus IoT](https://github.com/LABEIM/SmartCampus): Next-generation IoT campus infrastructure and smart telemetry (`?site=smart-campus`).
- [Sensor Network Research](https://github.com/LABEIM/SensorNet): High-density wireless mesh network and environmental sensing (`?site=sensor-net`).
